Commerce Platform System Map

Production request, identity, data, event, and telemetry paths for a Kubernetes-hosted commerce platform.

Reading Notes

System Shape

  • Clients enter through CDN and WAF edge controls before traffic reaches the API gateway inside the Kubernetes runtime.
  • Durable state is split across PostgreSQL, Redis, object storage, and Kafka; notifications run as a separate async consumer.

Critical Flows

  • The gateway validates OIDC tokens before forwarding requests to core services.
  • Orders are written synchronously to PostgreSQL; domain events are published to Kafka and consumed by the notification worker.

Operational Notes

  • Observability receives logs, metrics, traces, and alerts from every runtime component.
  • Notification delivery retries rely on Kafka retention rather than a database queue table (assumption).
